product_metadata.title: Pure Enrichment Genuine 2-in-1 True HEPA Replacement Filter for the PureZone Elite 4-in-1 Air Purifier - 2 Pack (PEAIRTWR)
features: 2-STAGE AIR PURIFICATION: Stage 1: Carbon Activated Pre-filter; Stage 2: True HEPA filter
CAPTURE + ELIMINATE HARMFUL PARTICLES: Our genuine filter cleans your air from 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns like dust, pollen, pet dander, smoke, and household odors
BREATHE EASIER: Only Pure Enrichment True HEPA filters improve air quality by helping to reduce allergens and improve sleep quality
LONG-LASTING: For optimal performance and to maintain the integrity of your air purifier, change your PureZone 2-in-1 True HEPA filter every 6 months
COMPATIBILITY: 2-in-1 air filter designed for the PureZone Elite 4-in1 Air Purifier (sold separately)
